subject: Clearwave Labs — Hosted API concession request
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@clearwavelabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwavelabs.com
Date: 2027-01-17T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Initial pricing request for pilot

Hi Ben,

Appreciate the demo last week — Clearwave is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We're planning a 12-month pilot (estimated 2.5M tokens/month initially, ramping to ~8M/month by Q4) across our triage automation and patient-summary features.

To make this budgetable for the board we need a meaningful volume concession. Target economics: ~25–30% off list Hosted API rates for the 12-month pilot with a 12-month minimum commitment. We'll also need basic SLA language and data isolation notes.

I've attached the draft SOW for scope. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a concession in this range and what the terms would be?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Sofia Martinez
Head of Product, Clearwave Labs
[Attachment: Clearwave_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial pricing request for pilot

Steph / Mina — forwarding Clearwave's ask (see below). They want a 12-month pilot with an immediate ramp target (2.5M -> 8M tokens/mo) and are explicitly requesting a 25–30% concession.

Quick context: Clearwave is a mid-size clinical AI vendor; strategic in our telehealth vertical and likely to expand to Dedicated in year two. Sales motion: 12-month pilot -> enterprise roll in 2028. They signed a basic NDA earlier this quarter and liked our perf during the trial.

Recommendation: approve a 28% one-time concession on Hosted API list for the 12-month pilot, contingent on (1) a 12-month committed minimum spend threshold ($120K/mo minimum), (2) Redwood-managed logging turned on for the account (no special exemption), and (3) inclusion of our standard pilot exit clause (no data retention beyond term). Pricing model and calc attached.

Why 28%: gets us into their board-level economics without preempting Dedicated pricing, preserves ability to step them up at renewal, and keeps unit economics neutral with prefix caching and batching.

Attachments: clearwave_pricing_v2.xlsx (breakdown + margin calc).

Let me know if you want a call — I can host the RAG deck.

—Ben
[Attachment: clearwave_pricing_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Ben — thanks for the context and the attached calc. A few quick items before I can greenlight anything at the >20% level: 

- We should avoid >25% unless there is a hard committed spend. Can you update the recommendation to cap at 25% and add the $/mo minimum you propose?
- Add a renewal cadence clause: pilot pricing reverts to list unless a conversion term is signed within 60 days of pilot end (we will need this to preserve renewal leverage).
- Legal: loop in to confirm the pilot exit/data retention language. Karthik, please confirm no unusual risk here.
- Finance: Mina, do you have runway for 25% on the margin side if we accept their proposed minimum? I need an exec OK for anything 20%+.

If Mina can sign off for 25% with the conditions above, authorize a one-time concession for the 12-month pilot only; anything deeper needs exec approval and a finance model.

I prefer a capped concession (25%) plus the commitment rather than a deeper discount. If Ben can get their agreement to the term, please record the updated pricing and send me a redline for DocuSign.

Thanks — Steph

Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial pricing request for pilot — Exec sign-off (25%)

Steph / Ben — reviewed the ask and the numbers. I approve a one-time 25% Hosted API concession for Clearwave's 12-month pilot on the conditions below: 

1) Commitment: Clearwave signs a 12-month minimum purchase commitment (we'll use Ben's $120K/mo floor) and pre-authorizes monthly invoices.
2) Term: Discount applies only to the 12-month pilot term; renewal will revert to list unless a conversion is executed.
3) Controls: Enable account-level logging and prefix caching; no special data retention exceptions.
4) Legal: Add a simple executive addendum that lists the concession and the ROI checkpoint after month 6. Legal to confirm quick redline.

Ben — I'm attaching the signed exec signoff PDF. Proceed to send the DocuSign (link below) and update HubSpot with the concession and committed minimum. Post the signed DocuSign in the deal record.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-9f7a
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DL-2027-0043
